[NOAA Hysplit single trajectory](https://www.ready.noaa.gov/hypub-bin/trajtype.pl)



- Select GFS model for global coverage


### Model Run Details 

#### Model parameters:

- Trajectory direction: forward
- Vertical motion: model vertical velocity - is isobaric a better choice?
- Start time: set to closest last balloon spot time hour
- Start 1 Lat/Lon: last spot location
- Level 1 height: last spot altitude - set to meters AMSL
  - can put mutiple altitudes to look at altitude sensitivity

#### Display options


- Plot met field along traj: yes
  - select Downward solar radiation.
